question: Is the following claim true? The Berlin Wall fell in 1989.
source: author-written for this project; verified by the author

claims.text: On November 9, 1989, East German authorities announced citizens could cross freely into West Berlin.
Crowds began opening the crossing points after the announcement.
This event is universally called the fall of the Berlin Wall and happened in 1989.
The wall was not physically dismantled in 1989.
'Fell' could be read as the wall's physical removal, placing it in 1990 or later.
'Fell' is somewhat figurative since the border function ended in 1989 without the structure coming down.
The claim uses 'fell' in its standard historical sense: when the wall stopped functioning as a barrier and the border opened.
The later physical demolition doesn't change the historical meaning of the event, so the claim is true.
